summary.name: arXiv
summary.one_liner: arXiv is a free, open-access archive and distribution service for scholarly preprints in physics, mathematics, computer science, quantitative biology, finance, statistics, electrical engineering, and economics.
use_cases: reading computer science papers before publication
searching quantitative finance or economics research
tracking new papers in a subfield
summary.what_it_does: The page describes arXiv as a free distribution service and open-access archive holding more than 3.2 million scholarly articles. It is organized into subject areas including physics (astrophysics, condensed matter, high energy physics, quantum physics, and more), mathematics, computer science (the Computing Research Repository), quantitative biology, quantitative finance, statistics, electrical engineering and systems science, and economics. Each category offers new, recent, and search listings. The page states that materials are not peer-reviewed by arXiv.
notable: Over 3.2 million open-access scholarly articles across many scientific fields
Subject-based listings with new, recent, and search views for each category
Materials are not peer-reviewed by arXiv
caveats: Materials are not peer-reviewed by arXiv
